sources.note_label: RotoWire 2026 survivor grid (updated Oct 19) / Pool Genius / SportsLine
sources.method: Win odds from RotoWire's 2026 grid (consensus lines as of Oct 19; current BKR lines differ by up to ~1.5 pts, e.g. HOU -10.5). Pick share and EV are Pool Genius figures quoted by FantasyAlarm on Oct 21, available only for HOU, MIN, DAL, NYJ; other teams have win odds only. KNOWN GAP: SurvivorGrid pick share/value score not fetchable from this session. Thursday teams (NE/CHI) omitted. Research/historical reference only (Andy is out of both survivor pools).
